timeline.tweet: The depth of my stomach is stirring. Numbness is starting to wash over my body. Letting loose the ties that bind me to consciousness - Each one of my senses trailing off, wobbling, trace tastes of yesterday on my tongue. Many thoughts disperse. One thought only now. Goodnight
I alternate between 3 moods this time of night 🙃😏🤤
I used to sleep. Now I just dream

I dropped out of school my senior year bc of social anxiety & the lack of resources I had to deal with it - I worked hard to overcome that & went directly into the workforce - now I have an amazing career - tomorrow I'm co-hosting a career day at my local high school. #WillPower

I was diagnosed with depression in February..some days are better than others. Talking about wrestling helps, even if my opinions aren't popular - it's an out. Every other weekend I get to be happy, too bad i have to live between those moments. This helps. You help. Thanks.

Manic/depression has caused me so much heartache. When I'm manic, I do so many things I regret and sometimes it lasts for months. When I'm depressed, I withdrawl and feel so much hate and stop caring about myself and others. There is no in between. Right now I'm manic. <3
